title: Schema REQ-009 S009-02/S009-04 status — provider-fact mapping pending C139-01; foundation sign-off pending REQ-140
body:
Status report from the public Bosak.Schema side for the two Schema owner work packages that gate the shared foundation work.

## Status: S009-02 — Provider facts, provenance and core-adapter mapping

- **State:** registered, ready to start for internal mapping/proofs; **not yet scheduled/started** by the Schema owner role.
- **Blocked at:** final production adapter binding — this waits for the accepted core C139-01 contract shape ([core REQ-139 packages](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/checkpoint/restart-2026-10-29/docs/REQ-139-OWNER-WORK-PACKAGES.md), still Pending; minimal C45 disposition required first).
- Planned posture is unchanged: expose only actual provider authority, preserve original assessment/PSVI, refuse the remainder explicitly; proposed core types or QName equality alone are not component authority.

## Status: S009-04 — Full-XSD-1.1 foundation requirements and joint freeze acceptance

- **State:** requirements work ready to start; **not yet scheduled/started**.
- **Blocked at:** final sign-off — follows the agreed bounded candidate, actual qualification evidence, and closure of the mapped API needs with core REQ-140; Schema signs off jointly with XmlDb. No freeze from decimal-only/prototype evidence.

## Since the registration (30 October 2026)

- REQ-009 S5c landed on `main`: open-content wildcards record the XSD 1.1 negative constraints `notNamespace`/`notQName` (Part 1 §3.10) with explicit `BSK-XSD-016` diagnostics; public suite is 124 tests green. This is add-side staged work within the existing scope — it does not change the S009-01–04 queue or claim structural enforcement.
- Package registration basis unchanged: `fd9f833` (+`243cc60`) on `feature/bounded-document-assessment`; native 0.9/v5 451-case qualification remains the finite recorded evidence.

## What unblocks the most

1. Core C45 disposition and C139-01 contract acceptance (core REQ-139) — unblocks S009-02 final binding.
2. REQ-140 foundation-gap closure on the agreed candidate — unblocks S009-04 sign-off.

Full package definitions and acceptance checklist: [REQ-009-OWNER-WORK-PACKAGES.md](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak.Schema/blob/feature/bounded-document-assessment/docs/REQ-009-OWNER-WORK-PACKAGES.md). Cross-reference: [core parallel owner work](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/checkpoint/restart-2026-10-29/docs/PARALLEL-OWNER-WORK.md), [foundation API freeze plan (REQ-140)](https://github.com/Fytala-Charles/Bosak/blob/checkpoint/restart-2026-10-29/docs/FOUNDATION-API-FREEZE-PLAN.md).
